new_text='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The dominant color is the canvas. Extend each row's final foreground run
    # into the remaining canvas, marking continuation cells with 1.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        fg_positions = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
        if not fg_positions:
            continue
        last = fg_positions[-1]
        if last == w - 1:
            continue
        fg = row[last]
        # Alternating foreground/background endings continue at period two.
        alternating = (last >= 1 and row[last - 1] == bg and
                       all(row[c] != row[c - 1] for c in range(max(1, last - 5), last + 1)))
        if alternating:
            for c in range(last + 1, w):
                if (c - last) % 2 == 1:
                    out[r][c] = 1
        else:
            for c in range(last + 1, w):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''

    candidates=[]
    p=3
    for r in range(h-1):
        last=max((c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg or grid[r+1][c]!=bg),default=-1)
        if last<0: continue
        for t in range(w-p+1):
            sig=tuple((grid[r][c],grid[r+1][c]) for c in range(t,t+p))
            if not any(a!=bg or b!=bg for a,b in sig): continue
            if not any(tuple((grid[rr][c],grid[rr+1][c]) for c in range(s,s+p))==sig
                       for rr in range(h-1) for s in range(w-p+1)
                       if not (rr==r and s==t)):
                continue
            if any((grid[r][c],grid[r+1][c]) != sig[(c-t)%p] for c in range(t+p,last+1)):
                continue
            candidates.append((t,r,sig,last))
    if candidates:
        t,r,sig,last=max(candidates,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
        for c in range(last+1,w):

            if grid[r][c]==bg and a!=bg: out[r][c]=1

        last=max((c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg),default=-1)
